Themes: a language model small enough to see
PresentationContext.VisualContinuity: Every graphic in the series is a CoCo screen: black on green, amber for the one thing that changed, navy for emphasis, uppercase blocky type.

Style.Rendering: Flat, pixel-precise illustration as if drawn by an MC6847 video chip: a 32-by-16 text grid of blocky 8-by-12 pixel glyphs, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no painterly texture. A faint CRT curvature and phosphor glow are allowed at the edges only.

Lighting.Shadows: None; the only dark areas are black ink on the field

Accents: Amber #FAE53D for the one thing that changed
Bar green #8EFF48 for inverse-video text on black
ColorPalette.Treatment: The field is bright green and everything on it is black; the screen is never dark. Amber marks the single element the viewer should look at; navy marks arrows and signs; nothing else is coloured. Never red on green.

Effects: Slight CRT barrel curvature at the frame edges
Soft phosphor bloom around bright areas
Atmosphere.Mood: Plain, exact, a machine showing its work

ContentDescription: The whole image is a CoCo text screen: a bright green field, the green of the reference image, with everything drawn on it in black. Never a dark or black background. Two tall tables side by side, headed POSITION 1 and POSITION 2 in blocky uppercase black letters. Each table is a column of about a dozen rows; each row has a label cell at the left and three empty cells to its right, all outlined in black on the green. In the left table one row is filled amber and its label cell reads <END>, with both angle brackets. In the right table one row is filled amber and its label cell reads COMMODORE, spelled C-O-M-M-O-D-O-R-E. Every other label cell is empty. Below the tables, one short block: the <END> row and the COMMODORE row shown again, one above the other, a navy plus sign to their left, a black bar under them, and under the bar a single row of three cells filled solid black, with the words ADD THEM to its left. Along the bottom of the screen, one caption line in black uppercase: ONE ROW FROM EACH TABLE. ADD THEM. THAT IS THE MODEL'S INPUT.
CompositionNotes: Bright green field, black ink, as in the reference image; the screen is never dark. The words to render, and only these, spelled exactly: POSITION 1, POSITION 2, <END>, COMMODORE, ADD THEM, and the caption ONE ROW FROM EACH TABLE. ADD THEM. THAT IS THE MODEL'S INPUT. All other cells are empty. No numbers anywhere. Amber fills exactly two rows. Navy is used only for the plus sign.
